name: Python: Function & Loop
description: Python function definition with loop and formatted print output.
source_code:
def compute_factorial(n):
    result = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        result *= i
    return result

val = 5
print(f"Factorial of {val} is {compute_factorial(val)}")
